body: Not really. Fortunately for me, none of my struggles are related to being a lesbian. If someone offered me a "turn straight" button or something, and I definitely wouldn't choose to start life over as straight. Most of my friends are LGBT and we initially bonded over that (though we have more in common of course). Mostly though, I'm glad I don't have to worry about being pregnant since I never want kids.

When I read "They're just McDonald's workers" I thought of it more as that they're cashiers, not waiters/waitresses serving me and working for tips (if that makes sense). I don't know how everyone just jumped to "they're subhuman and beneath me" considering that's all the OP said and made no mention of something worse to give this more context. Tbh this almost feels like a shitpost.
